_comment: Generated 2026-04-26. v3 — corrections from diff review against live mapping. Three real fixes: (1) resources.class is a regular `lookup` not a derive, (2) tasks.linkId scoped to WorkOrderCode + Order (verified against captured data: WorkOrderCode 100% populated 797 distinct; Order has clean routing values 1-22; SequenceNumber has sentinel 32767/9999/9998 patterns and is unsuitable), (3) tasks.actualStart simplified to a regular passthrough (engine's existing null-handling produces the desired behavior). Two genuine engine gaps remain: orders.lateDueDate (cross-field reference) and tasks.wipState (multi-condition derive). NOT yet applied to live config — see mapping-apply-plan-v3.md for staged rollout.
_adapter_note: Orders sourced from workOrderWithAdvancedInformationViewEntity. Adapter wiring must be updated alongside applying the orders section — see Sprint B in apply plan.

lateDueDate._TODO: engine does not support cross-field references; intent is to default lateDueDate to the value of dueDate (zero tolerance) when no late-tolerance source exists. Until the engine supports @-references or a similar primitive, this rule is declarative — engine ignores it and lateDueDate falls to default 0. JobEndDate may be the right late-tolerance signal — see Stafford escalation #6.

mappings._comment_enrichment_fields: Customer-facing data from work orders. UI/filter use; engine doesn't currently consume.

mappings._comment_new_fields: New resource attributes surfaced by the audit. Engine doesn't consume them yet; data-layer captures everything.

wipState._TODO: engine does not yet support multi-condition derive — only genuine engine gap remaining in this proposal. Stafford confirmation needed: are PRINTED/CREATED/PLANNED in WoStatusCode the lifecycle states (which would let this be a simpler lookup)? If so, this becomes from+lookup; if not, the IsCompleted+TaskStartDate fallback below is needed.
